I am an anarcho-communist. I view communism as the way to go for the human race and I see authority and unnecessary hierarchy as detrimental things to progress.

Anarcho-communism is an end goal to me. A society without bosses, a society where the doctor and the politician can have a drink together with the trucker and sewage cleaner, where they see each other as equals. I see it as a society where everyone works together and all advances made are shared with the entirety of humanity. I hope that we will reach a day where all people can all decide what should happen, where everyone gets an equal share of the fruits of the labour of everyone.

It may seem utopian, and it is. You may think utopia's are dumb, naive, or even childish. I disagree. Sure, we may never achieve utopia, but that is not what utopia is for. Just like superhero's, it is an ideal to strive for. We will never have the perfect moral compass of a superhero, we will never reach utopia, but we can strive to get as close to it as we can, we can strive to improve ourselves and to do the best we can.

This is what anarchism is to me.
